The Last Guardian - PC build (work in progress)
===============================================

Start:     the Desktop or Start menu shortcut, "Play.bat", or "The Last Guardian.exe" here
Shortcuts: Install.bat creates them (Install.bat -Remove deletes them)
Game data: D:\Games\CUSA03627, version 01.03 (read only, never modified; the path is in
           game_path.txt)
Saves:     user\home\1000\savedata\CUSA03627
Bindings:  user\input_config\CUSA03627.ini  (F8 reloads it while the game runs)

Options:   this build's settings are rows of the game's own Options screen (from the title
           screen and from the pause menu): below the game's lines come Graphics and
           Key Bindings, then Back. There is no separate settings window.
             GRAPHICS      VSync, fullscreen, window size, FSR upscaling, sharpening,
                           frame rate counter, language (English, Francais, Espanol,
                           Portugues: the languages of this copy of the game).
             KEY BINDINGS  every action with its keys; select one, then press the key or
                           mouse button to use.

Keyboard and mouse (defaults):
           W A S D        move              mouse            camera
           Space          jump              C                crouch
           E, right mouse pick up / grab    F, left mouse    tackle / throw
           R              call Trico        Left Ctrl        contemplate (hold)
           Left / 3       wield or put away the mirror
           Esc            pause             Tab              touch pad
           Q, Z, X        L1, L2, R2        middle mouse     R3
           In menus: arrow keys, Enter to select, Backspace to go back.
           F7 frees the mouse, F11 toggles fullscreen.

Controllers: Xbox, DualShock, DualSense and others through SDL; the layout is the console's.

Button pictures follow the device in use: the tutorial hints and the pause menu's Controls
guide show a keyboard, an Xbox controller or the PlayStation controller. The keyboard
pictures show the default keys.
